name: Natsuiro Sagittarius
source:
Just before summer holiday... Oujiro is told to join the Japanese archery club by Aika and Airi, his old friends. As a matter of fact, they are the only club members. There is no choice for him. 

There are now three members in total though five members are necessary to carry on the club. Will they be able to get two more members to join?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
暑假前夕……王次郎被旧友爱佳与爱理要求加入弓道部。实际上，她们是社团仅有的两名成员，他根本没有选择余地。

如今社团共有3人，但要继续存在，至少需要5名成员。他们能够再招到两个人吗？

[摘自ErogeShop]
